description: Ausgrid Average Electricity Use – 2011 is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Ausgrid. Ausgrid is providing the following data on electricity consumption within our network area for the 2010/2011 financial year to be used in developing applications. The data is from customer billing data and grouped by local government areas (LGA) in Ausgridas network. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Ausgrid. Its tags are ausgrid, electricity, energy. It offers 1 resource(s) in PDF. The portal shows 2023-08-09 as the last metadata change. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
